sentences.text: Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Jitendra Kumar Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1. Heard Sri Sandeep Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State.
2. None appeared for informant.

3. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 35 of 2023, under Sections 376, 313, 323, 504, 506, 307, 147 IPC, Police Station Khoda, District-Ghaziabad, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Prosecutrix is a major lady, aged about 22 years.

As per prosecution version, the applicant has taken the victim to his house and after administering some Sahdev vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169283387/
1 intoxicant in her cold drink, he committed rape upon her and also took her photograph.
Learned counsel has referred the statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and submitted that there are material contradictions in her statement.
She has stated that applicant has taken her to his house for talk of her marriage and in statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she has stated that she has gone to the house of the applicant.
There is no such medical evidence that prosecutrix has suffered any abortion.
Similarly, the allegation that the applicant and his family members have tried to strangulate the deceased is wholly false and same is also not supported by medical evidence.
As per prosecution, applicant has committed rape upon victim on pretext of marriage but the said allegation is wholly false.
The attending facts show that the prosecutrix was a consenting party.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is in jail since 15.1.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial..
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application and submitted that prosecutrix has made allegation of rape against the applicant.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant Sahdev involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant-accused shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant-accused shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant-accused shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv.
The applicant-accused shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

iv. The applicant-accused shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant-accused in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Kumar Manish.
